The Family Care Snapshot Checklist

The people, routines and information to write down while Mom is doing fine.

Download PDF

Mom is doing fine, mostly, and nothing has happened. This is a list of what to ask about, list and write down so the family has one picture of how her week works today. You have time, so it can be done over a few ordinary visits. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is something for another visit, not a verdict about Mom or about anyone who helps her.

Ask

List

Write

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you ask, list and write down. It doesn't say how Mom is managing, or whether the help around her is the right amount. A checklist can't tell you that, and this one doesn't try.

Ready for the next step?

You've asked, listed and written down how Mom's week works today. The care interview goes through her situation area by area, including the parts no one in the family has thought to mention, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.

Where this comes from

The item marked 1 follows AARP's Prepare to Care guide, and the item marked 2 follows the Family Caregiver Alliance's Caregiving 101. The rest come from the Family Care Roadmap's own working list for this step.
